name: Forgnash
ability: Rough Skin / Flash Fire / Tough Claws (hidden)
look: a standing land shark with a huge toothy grin, glowing orange eyes, horns, orange fins, flames exploding from its back and huge red claws
entry: Once it stands on two legs, the fire inside it bursts out through its back. It hammers metal ore with its claws to sharpen them, and the sparks fly like a forge.
how: Wild: extremely rare in volcanic biomes.
